game.name: Smol Ame
game.rules:
All runs require video proof with audio.

- Video must show the full run in its entirety.
- The game version in the bottom right corner must be visible and readable at all times (do not cover it with any overlays).
- The in-game FPS counter must be active and visible at all times (can be activated in the menu and appears in the bottom left corner). This rule will only be enforced for runs in the competitive range.
- The In-Game Timer must be visible and readable upon completing any stage.
- The video you submit must be setup to be permanent (eg YouTube, Twitch highlights). Recent Broadcasts on Twitch will auto-delete, so will not be approved.
- Timestamps are required if the run is part of a longer video.

Runs must be played in a single segment with no quit-outs. For categories using the In-Game Timer pausing is also not allowed.

Runs can be played  on any official release of the game (but not test versions), which can be found under the resources tab, or on the web version at https://kevincow.itch.io/smol-ame (unofficial 3rd party web versions will not be accepted).

Modified game versions, TAS runs, and macros are not allowed and the game must run at a minimum of 30 FPS at all times.

categories.name: Any% (v0.210306)
categories.rules:
1. Must be using an up-to-date version of Smol Ame from @Kevin : https://kevincow.itch.io/smol-ame that is unmodified.
2. Proof must be provided. Through video, the more notable the run the more scrutiny it will undergo.
Video submissions should only contain the run being submitted, not an entire recording session and must contain audio of the game.
3. Moderates will asses every run so they may take time to be confirmed.
4. All proof must include the version number
5. No glitch/lag based jumps as they are hardware dependent and are unreliable 
6. No TAS, Macros or Computer based inputs
7. No pausing during a game, either in-game pausing or tabbing out.
8. Must be completed in a single run
9. Include the version number in all proof
10. Complete every stage
11. You can do the stages in any order
12. The timer starts at level start
13. The timer ends when you hit the last mom in a run

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
# Objectives:

* Complete the stage as quickly as possible by ground pounding the MOM button.  

# Restrictions:

* Pausing the game is not allowed at any point during the run.
* Game version, FPS counter, and the final time must be visible and readable.  

# Timing Method:

* In-Game Time is used for timing this category. Only fill in the "in-game time" slot when submitting runs.
* The time is displayed on screen upon completing the stage.

# Restrictions:

* Pausing the game is not allowed at any point during the run.

* The time is displayed on screen upon completing the stage.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
# Objectives:

- Complete the game from a fresh save file. Any save file with no stages completed is considered fresh.  
- In version 1.0 the game is considered completed upon finishing the stage NOTHING.
- In version 0.210831.1 the game is considered completed upon ground pounding "The Final Update" button, also referred to as the Calli button.  

# Restrictions:

- The use of console commands is forbidden. That means no holding L to unlock all stages.  
- Save file manipulation is prohibited.  
- The act of ground pounding MOM must be visible for all stages beaten during the run. Having the in-game timer be visible and readable for a couple of frames is both necessary and sufficient to satisfy this criteria. In version 0.210831.1 an exception to this is rushia level where the error message has to be visible instead.  

# Timing Method:

- Real time is used for timing this category. Only fill in the "real time" slots when submitting runs.
- Timing starts on the last frame before the level transition (last frame where the entire screen is black) when loading Ame's Office.  
- In version 1.0 timing ends on the first frame of the level transition after finishing NOTHING. 
- In version 0.210831.1 timing ends on the first frame where a ground pound hits the Calli button.

categories.name: All Stages
categories.rules:
# Objectives:

- Complete all stages in the game.  
- A stage is considered completed upon ground pounding the MOM button at the end.  
- Stages can be beaten in any order.   

# Restrictions:

- The act of ground pounding MOM must be visible for all stages beaten during the run. Having the in-game timer be visible and readable for a couple of frames is both necessary and sufficient to satisfy this criteria. An exception is rushia level where the error message has to be visible instead.  

# Timing Method:

- Real time is used for timing this category. Only fill in the "real time" slots when submitting runs.
- Timing starts on the last frame before the level transition into the first stage (last frame where the entire screen is black).  
- Timing ends on the first frame of the level transition after beating the last stage of the run.

categories.name: Bubba%
categories.rules:
# Objectives:

- Collect all Bubba tokens in the game.  
- A Bubba token is first considered collected upon ground pounding the MOM button after picking up all 3 Bubba tokens in a stage.  
- Stages can be completed in any order.  

# Restrictions:

- The act of ground pounding MOM must be visible for all stages beaten during the run. Having the in-game timer be visible and readable for a couple of frames is both necessary and sufficient to satisfy this criteria. An exception is rushia level where the error message has to be visible instead.  

# Timing Method:

- Real time is used for timing this category. Only fill in the "real time" slots when submitting runs.
- Timing starts on the last frame before the level transition into the first stage (last frame where the entire screen is black).  
- Timing ends on the first frame of the level transition after beating the last stage of the run.

categories.name: Case Closed
categories.rules:
# Objectives:

- Complete all stages in the game while clearing the "Case Closed" conditions on each stage.  
- Case Closed is achieved by filling the stache quota, collecting all 3 Bubba tokens, and not dying in a single run.  
- Stages can be completed in any order.  

# Restrictions:

- The act of ground pounding MOM must be visible for all stages beaten during the run. Having the in-game timer be visible and readable for a couple of frames is both necessary and sufficient to satisfy this criteria. An exception is rushia level where the error message has to be visible instead.  

# Timing Method:

- Real time is used for timing this category. Only fill in the "real time" slots when submitting runs.
- Timing starts on the last frame before the level transition into the first stage (last frame where the entire screen is black).  
- Timing ends on the first frame of the level transition after beating the last stage of the run.

categories.name: ABC
categories.rules:
# Objectives:

- Do an any%, Bubba%, and Case Closed run of each stage in the game.  
- These definitions are strict in the sense that any run where all 3 Bubba tokens is collected cannot count as clearing the any% condition of the stage. Similarly if the Case Closed conditions are cleared the run cannot count towards the any% or Bubba% count on the stage.  
- Stages can be completed in any order.  

# Restrictions:

- The act of ground pounding MOM must be visible for all stages beaten during the run. Having the in-game timer be visible and readable for a couple of frames is both necessary and sufficient to satisfy this criteria. An exception is rushia level where the error message has to be visible instead.  
- Resetting during the dance animation/error message is still possible. Just make sure that these have been visible for at least a couple of frames.  

# Timing Method:

- Real time is used for timing this category. Only fill in the "real time" slots when submitting runs.
- Timing starts on the last frame before the level transition into the first stage (last frame where the entire screen is black).  
- Timing ends on the first frame of the level transition after beating the last stage of the run.

levels.name: rushia level
levels.rules:
# IMPORTANT:

Since rushia level does not display In-Game Time at the end like other stages, there are special rules for running the stage. One of the following two conditions must be met to have a run verified.

1) Use the speedrun patch and have the in-game timer displayed throughout the entire run.

2) The video proof must show the entire play session, starting with entering the stage from the hub (showing the old best time). The personal best time displayed in the hub world will then be used instead. Video proof should be time stamped for when the actual run occurs.
